summary.lv: Aerones Engineering meklē AI Native DevOps inženieri, kurš uzturēs un uzlabos R&D un inženieru komandu infrastruktūru, automatizēs CI/CD cauruļvadus un pārvaldīs konteinerizētas aplikācijas Google Cloud un edge vidēs.
summary.en: Aerones Engineering is looking for an AI Native DevOps Engineer to build and maintain infrastructure for R&D and engineering teams, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and manage containerized applications across Google Cloud and edge environments.
